name: Context menu on rows and in the viewport
body:
# Context menu

Right-click on a row (and on an entity in the viewport, when not orbiting) opens a menu: Rename, Duplicate, Delete,
Focus, Hide, Lock, Parent to..., Unparent, Add child >. Shares `Menu.chaos` with the menu bar.

comments.text: Done 2026-10-27 for outliner rows: WasSecondaryMouseButtonPressed (new on the Nyx Application bridge) plus the hovered row opens a MenuPopup with EditorMenus.ContextEntries. Right-click in the viewport orbits, so it has no menu.
